name: Nourishing the Fire
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level alchemist 2, druid 2, shaman 2, witch 2

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a knife)

EFFECT

Range self
Area 30-foot aura
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You cut your hand and take 1 point of damage, then cast your blood into the air while chanting the spell.

For the duration all fires and fire effects within the area are empowered. All fire-based lights increase their bright and dim light radii by 10 feet. All fire-based spells and effects increase their DC by 1 if the effect is within the aura. Additionally all fire damage dealt within the radius is increased by 1 per dice of fire damage dealt, or by 1 if no dice are used. Finally, any creature with the fire subtype gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage while within the aura.
